periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Near-vertical orientation, approximately 80 degrees relative to the longitudinal axis of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Pronounced oval profile with vertical elongation significantly exceeding horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering where the patch area expands ventrally from the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary at the transition point between the dark shoulder band and white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, covering approximately 40-50% of the visible torso height from the lateral perspective.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the maximum width of the right pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly smooth, semicircular convex curvature across the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant exposure of the dentition (canines and incisors) resulting from an open-mouth, cephalic-tilt posture.
